photos.title: Myrtle Beach oceanfront houses, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: Older houses on wide lawns facing the beach in Myrtle Beach, with walkways over the dunes, Ocean Boulevard behind them, and streets of houses under oaks beyond.
photos.caption: Houses on wide lawns behind the dunes, facing the beach in Myrtle Beach, with wooden walkways down to the sand.
photos.alt: Two-story houses on wide green lawns behind the dunes, with wooden walkways to the beach and oak trees behind, seen from a plane over the ocean in Myrtle Beach
photos.author: U.S. Geological Survey
photos.credit: Photo: U.S. Geological Survey, public domain. Credit not required; give it anyway.
photos.provenance: U.S. government photo: USGS baseline coastal oblique aerial survey 11CCH03 (Ponte Vedra, Florida, to the South Carolina/North Carolina border), flown 2011-08-24, photographer Karen L.M. Morgan (USGS). Frame 2011_0824_180133d.jpg from https://coastal.er.usgs.gov/data-release/doi-F7N877XX/data/11CCH03_0824_180000.zip; aircraft position 33.715463 N, -78.842893 W (11CCH03-Photolocations.csv and the file's EXIF GPS; the position of the plane, not of the buildings). Data release: Morgan, K.L.M., 2017, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7N877XX. Not the frame used on any other page (other pages use 174830, 175156, 175537, 180052, 180608 and 181208).
photos.license_note: USGS metadata, Use_Constraints: 'Public domain data from the U.S. Government are freely redistributable with proper metadata and source attribution. Please recognize the U.S. Geological Survey as the originator of the dataset.'
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer on 2026-11-02. Points 525 to 550 m inland of the plane, 250 m either side, all fall in the R-zone class (no rentals under 90 days). No person, sign or readable house number at page size.

photos.title: Little River waterfront and Mariner's Pointe from above, NAIP aerial, April 2023
photos.what: The Intracoastal Waterway at Little River from straight above on April 10, 2023: the slip basin of Mariner's Pointe, ringed by red-roofed condo buildings, at the lower left; the docks and boats of the waterfront at the end of Mineola Avenue at the right; marsh and long private piers between them; the wide dark waterway across the bottom and woods and marsh on its far bank. Labels: Mariner's Pointe, Waterfront, Intracoastal Waterway.
photos.caption: The Intracoastal Waterway at Little River from above, with boats at the docks at the end of Mineola Avenue and in the slip basin at Mariner's Pointe.
photos.alt: The Intracoastal Waterway at Little River from above: a slip basin full of boats ringed by condo buildings, labelled Mariner's Pointe, and docks with boats at the end of a street, labelled Waterfront

place.sublocation: The waterfront at Mineola Avenue and Mariner's Pointe, on the Intracoastal Waterway
